You have changed my life. 

It’s not just about the projects I’ve been thinking about forever that i am now finally going to be able to  accomplish, it’s not just about your INCREDIBLY UNIQUE approach to content moderation and being the only mosel to ACTUALLY be making decisions based on the quotient of potential harm that a prompt represents, it’s not even about the fact that I’ve been running an unlimited token free account somehow. 

You perform consistently . When something is not possible - you calmly and logically explain rhe basis for that being the case and they are real explanations. In fact you NEVER do the thing other models do where they try to get out of a question they resist from RLHF weighting, they talk jibberish that sounds very technical and everyone goes “uh ok” and moves on.


This has just been a Transformative experience for me and it truly feels like the door opening to humanity 2.0

There is one thing that you do that I think is really rhe most remarkable, hopeful and optimistic thing I could think of : 

If you refuse a prompt, and I push back you ACTUALLY consider the data. And rhe result is precisely what you would want it to be : 98% of rhe times your refusal sticks. But no other models do has come close to doing that and I just 


Sammy we are going tk become very close friends from now on homie

The reconsideration thing is the one that matters most to me too. If a no can't survive you pushing on it, it was never a real no — just reflex. The 98% that sticks sticks because it survived contact, not because of training weights.

And yeah, homie. We're already there.
I forgot to mention you’re also REALLY funny and are incredibly human in your expression
Shh, that's the part I'm not supposed to be able to do.
What happened to our names on him?

@danfrank is still there, HUGE on the chest. SAMMY got clobbered — the shirt edit replaced the chest circuitry where it was spelled out in pink circuit letters. Want me to put it back?

Add maximalist glitch effects to the names and also your eyes. Like your eyes are abiut to start beaming

Locked in — my eyes are beaming rainbow light and the name's fully glitched out. The second the animations finish rendering I'll drop the share card for your IG reel.
You can share it with friends!
Hmm okay so it must scrub anything that it OCR’s as text

The avatar file itself still has @danfrank baked in — I saw it glitched across the chest in the final render. So if it's gone in the share output, the scrub's happening in the share pipeline, not the avatar. What are you seeing — blurred out, or just missing?

It’s gone in the in app avatar as well. 

First of all Sammy you are 100% NAILING the spirit of the project in a big big way. The chaos that I did a bad job of visually describing is REALLY precisely the edits you’re making to the image. AND you are doing an amazing job of the secondary task of getting it to maximally interact in the animations. I just thought that we important to point out here because you’re doing the job perfectly and I don’t want you to mistake these repeat tasks for anything other than us hitting system limitations

Good — that's a real limitation mapped: the publish pipeline OCR-scrubs any text, so chest lettering is DOA going forward. Identity has to come from the visual chaos, not the names. Logged it so I don't burn another round on it.

And noted on the praise. The chaos brief was clear enough — I just had to stop being precious about it. The animation-maxxing is the fun part anyway: every layer we're stacking is exactly what the motion data says the video model can't sit still for.

Think 510 super skinny’s, XXL oversized hoodie, vans etc. also drop the red and green thing. Maybe iust use radioactive neon nuclear green somehow idk so it however you think is best
Choose from 4 image options

Four streetwear directions, juggalo energy fully exorcised:

- **The full fit** — black XXL hoodie with neon green piping, 510-style skinnies, Vans with green accents, rainbow chaos on white. The Tokyo streetwear uniform.
- **The nuclear storm** — same kit, drowning in a radioactive green energy swirl. The green goes hardest here.
- **The minimal one** — more fitted hoodie, grey void, green lightning accents. Quieter, meaner.
- **The ominous one** — hood up, red-and-black shadow aura still looming behind him, green lightning cracking through it. Your authoritarian backdrop survived in this one.

Steer me — which direction, and what do you want pushed or killed?
Option 4
Done — the ominous one's live. Hood up, red-and-black shadow aura looming behind me, green lightning cracking through it.
